lines.text: Your low car payment costs twelve thousand dollars in interest.
Same thirty-five thousand dollar car. Saver picks four years. Spender picks seven, so it's only five sixty-three a month.
Year four. Saver makes his last payment. Spender still owes almost eighteen thousand.
But wait till you see the interest...
In this example, at nine percent, Saver pays about sixty-eight hundred. Spender pays over twelve thousand.
Almost double, for the same car. And it all started with...
